content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ESIC Advocate Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.esic.nic.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 31-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ESIC Advocate recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the ESIC Advocate recruitment is 31st August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the required qualification for the Advocate post at ESIC?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor Degree in Law from a recognized university and be enrolled with the Bar Council of India or any State Bar Council. Additionally, 5-10 years of professional experience is required.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for the ESIC Advocate position?
faq.answer: The application process is offline. You need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official address mentioned in the notification before the last date.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the ESIC Advocate recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the ESIC Advocate recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the job type for the Advocate post at ESIC?
faq.answer: The Advocate post at ESIC is a contractual job type.

faq.question: Q6. Where is the ESIC Advocate recruitment located?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, with a pincode of 208005.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Advocate role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves scrutiny of applications, shortlisting, and potentially an interaction or interview, followed by approval and notification of the panel.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply online for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for this recruitment is strictly offline.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website of ESIC?
faq.answer: The official website of ESIC is www.esic.nic.in.
